notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) via background subagents, covering 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01. All four lanes hit routine EGRESS_BLOCKED on most org-domain WebFetch attempts (openai.com, anthropic.com, nvidia.com, learn.microsoft.com, aws.amazon.com, support.google.com, cisa.gov, blog.qualys.com) and worked from WebSearch snippets quoting those pages instead, per the sandbox's normal behavior. Highlights: Google DeepMind's same-day Gemini 4 Argon launch, a same-day White House 'self-police AI' accord and a same-day Google antitrust win dismissing the Chegg/Penske AI-content suits, a notable DIVD disclosure of an autonomous-AI-agent-driven breach chaining two Zammad zero-days, and several genuinely new deprecation/EOL dates (AWS Chime SDK/WorkSpaces Secure Browser maintenance mode, Google Cloud Node.js 20 Cloud Run decommission, Redis Software 7.4 EOL, Windows 11 24H2 Home/Pro end of servicing). Dropped several AI-lane candidates that turned out to already be accurately on the calendar (OpenAI's realtime/audio and whisper/transcribe retirements) or that risked clobbering a confirmed entry with a lower-confidence conflicting one (see concerns re: Azure GPT-4.1/GPT-4o 2027-04-14).
concerns: One AI-lane candidate was deliberately NOT filed to avoid a bad merge: a secondary source describes Azure AI Foundry retiring GPT-4.1 (2025-04-14 version) and GPT-4o (2024-08-06 version) on 2027-04-14, but the calendar already has a confirmed 'Azure AI Foundry retires GPT-4.1 model family' entry dated 2026-10-14. A maintainer with direct access should check learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/concepts/model-retirement-schedule and reconcile both dates before either is touched again.
